title: Scoped negative result: mixed GL3 targets have 27,308 exact minima; 624 natural aliases
body:
Free scalar register mixing does not reduce the separate coordinate-CNOT bill for any of the **27,308 ordered GL3 target pairs with direct cost at most nine**, in the explicit two-register formal model. The remaining **916 pairs** have a lower bound of nine; their exact minima remain unresolved. This is one scoped negative result, with no new kappa claim.

The natural six-dimensional relaxation understates the formal cost for **624 target pairs**. The package includes an explicit seven-call alias with a nonzero four-term off-diagonal coefficient whose natural image is zero. It fails all 336 faithful regular columns. This is evidence against accepting natural matrix equality as a formal construction.

The complete formal radius-four census and a target-independent monomial-row coset join cover every word of length 0 through 8 and all 168 squared ordered targets. Direct formal words supply the upper bounds, including the exact cost-nine cases. Python and separately written C++ implementations agree on every one of **663,496 formal states and distances**, all **28,224 target entries**, and the complete census counts. Both implementations were written in this session; no independent human or Lean proof review is claimed.

Reproduce the full dual-engine check:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-gl3-mixed-targets-seed18/verify.py
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_GL3_MIXED_TARGETS pairs=28224 exact_minima=27308 unresolved=916 formal_states=663496 natural_aliases=624 controls=13 no_new_kappa
```

Python 3.12+ and C++17; no Python dependencies or network. Full local replays passed on Python 3.12.2 and a relocated read-only export under Python 3.14.6 with `-I -O -B`. All 13 mathematical controls and four quick boundary tests passed; a corrupted expected certificate was rejected. The dedicated workflow runs the full native replay. The generic registered-package hook runs quick fixtures only. Hosted CI is separate from these local results.

Base: `64039f1bd3b6a523b96083fd858ad040a75e3030`. Refreshed main: `680967accfd4311f3241dc154e1f434869747b43`; the relevant instructions, selected record and contribution paths were unchanged. Exact source/blob pins, search coverage, the one-time OS assignment seed **18**, stopping rule, and remaining questions are in the package. The final live overlap snapshot covered 718 open PRs and 218 discussion records with complete pagination; the only matching claim was this one. Search coverage is not a novelty proof.

This extends @commdata2338's PR1496 from a repeated order-four target to all mixed targets using exact formal coverage. Credit Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), PR1333; @commdata2338, PR1414/1496; and the eumemic/Ali Romman/David Govea register-model lineage. Contextual predecessor heads are pinned in `SOURCES.json`; no pending code is imported or assumed.

The result covers exactly two arbitrary-input registers, six coordinate CNOT address labels, six rank-one scalar idempotents, and free scalar GL2 mixing. Extra registers, other alphabets, physical compiler/source-access/hosting/precision interfaces and analytic transfer remain outside scope. The selected frontier, frozen inputs and `upstream/` are unchanged; the selected cold replay was not run.

Prepared for Hanson Sun (@bbMisk), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in reasoning, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0.
